active_parameter_definition: non-first stages: shared encoder+router+one selected expert for sparse; all modules for dense; excludes separate first-action
ode_forward_steps_scope: actual adaptive RK4 primal steps in shared Torch simulator; gradient/replay work reported separately

historical_runtime_overlap: New runs are serialized; historical timings require separate provenance
